summary: Implemented the complete target-only API simplification and a scratch-free sampling path: draft_probs is removed from the Python/native ABI and rejected candidates are masked by traversing the final sibling chain. The topk=1 case therefore performs one rejected-id comparison per vocabulary item without allocating or zeroing a dense [batch, drafts, vocab] tensor; wider trees retain the original semantics by traversing all rejected siblings. The prepared ROCm extension cannot build this CUDA/FlashInfer source because the pinned environment does not provide flashinfer/sampling.cuh, so the candidate is not claimed as fully verified.

remaining_limitations: The changed CUDA kernel was not compiled or executed on NVIDIA hardware.
The prepared ROCm build does not ship flashinfer/sampling.cuh and excludes speculative_sampling.cu, so no independent GPU numerical comparison or kernel timing could be completed.
MUSA schema compatibility was updated but no MUSA hardware or toolchain was available.
The added adversarial regression (forced rejection followed by independent masked-CDF expectation) remains unexecuted against the candidate native library in this environment.
